title: Niche hotel booking site
summary: Hotel booking for a specific traveller niche.
whyTempting: OTAs are generic and niche travellers are underserved.
whyItFails: OTA dominance. Booking giants win on inventory and price. Customer acquisition. Search ads are expensive. Thin commissions. Little margin left.

attempts.notes: Last-minute hotel deals; bought for about $450 million.

attempts.outcome: Unprofitable; put up for sale by TripAdvisor

reasons.detail: OTA dominance: Booking giants win on inventory and price.
Customer acquisition: Search ads are expensive.
